enneagram.reason: The Three case is argued from repeated costly behavior across Loopt, YC and OpenAI: accommodation in the room, indirect pursuit outside it, and trust lost each time. Each rival is tested with a named discriminator: Four (what the public face protects; credible over distinctive), Eight (indirect sidelining, not open fighting), Nine/Two (the agenda survives the room), Seven (lost usefulness, one title), Six (named the largest gap). The salesman-craft confound is stated as unresolvable, which is why confidence stays medium. Residuals (the speech at 17, the Musk email, 'missing circuit') are left unexplained rather than explained away. Limits: the credible-over-distinctive test rests on few examples, and the 9/2 discriminator leans partly on a compilation passage.
enneagram.passage: The strongest rival to any type is the job: a fundraiser is paid to tell each audience what it wants. The habit persisted when it hurt him, at Loopt, at YC and in the 2023 firing. But it began with his first job, so timing can't separate craft from motive, which is much of why confidence stays at medium.
